jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:

 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

jobs.occupation: EXTERNAL SALES ACCOUNT MANAGER  DACH & UK
jobs.description:
Grow the market. Build the right partnerships. Strengthen the Manutti brand.

Manutti is a Belgian luxury outdoor furniture brand with strong international ambitions.

To accelerate our growth in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, we are looking for an experienced sales professional with a strong background in premium outdoor furniture and luxury design, a deep understanding of dealer networks and a genuine drive to develop markets through strong personal relationships.

This is a highly international role. You will spend a significant amount of time in your target markets, close to customers, prospects and opportunities, while remaining strongly connected to the Manutti team through regular presence at our headquarters in Belgium.

As External Sales Manager DACH & UK, you take commercial ownership of your markets.

You will:

• 
Grow and strengthen our network of premium dealers

• 
Identify and onboard new high-potential partners

• 
Develop existing accounts and drive sustainable growth

• 
Increase showroom visibility, product presence and sell-through

• 
Identify opportunities within retail and project business

• 
Build strong relationships with dealers, architects, designers and key partners

• 
Represent Manutti at customer meetings, events and international fairs

• 
Stay close to the market and turn opportunities into concrete results

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a commercially driven relationship builder with the instinct of a hunter and the discipline of a strong account manager.

You bring:

• 
Solid international B2B sales experience

• 
Proven experience in premium outdoor furniture, luxury furniture or high-end design

• 
Strong experience with dealer and distribution networks

• 
A track record in both new business and key account development

• 
A strong affinity with luxury, architecture and design

• 
An autonomous, entrepreneurial and result-driven mindset

• 
The flexibility and willingness to travel extensively

Fluent German and English are essential.

Additional languages are a strong asset.

ViaMotive is not a traditional company. As a multi-brand dealer for brands such as Higer, Temsa and EVM, we provide smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

With the growing number of electric buses, our workshop is changing too. That's why we're looking for a skilled 
Diagnostic Bus Technician to join our team.
 

At ViaMotive, you will diagnose technical problems on modern buses and work together with your colleagues to get our vehicles safely back on the road. Every day is different and offers new technical challenges.
 

Your job
 

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will find, analyse and solve technical problems on buses.
 

Your tasks include:
 
 

• Diagnosing technical faults using diagnostic equipment. 

• Reading fault codes and electrical diagrams. 

• Solving mechanical, electrical and electronic problems. 

• Carrying out maintenance and repairs. 

• Testing vehicles after repairs. 

• Helping colleagues with more complex technical issues. 

• Learning about new technologies, including electric buses. 

Who are you?
 
 

• You have a degree in Automotive Technology, Electromechanics, or similar experience. 

• You have experience as a diagnostic technician, bus technician or truck technician. 

• You have a good knowledge of mechanics, electricity and electronics. 

• You have experience using diagnostic tools. 

• You have a category B driving licence (category D is a plus). 

• You can communicate in English or Dutch. 

• You work accurately, care about quality and enjoy working in a team.  

Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is an advantage, but not required. A strong technical mindset and willingness to learn are just as important.
 

Practical
 
 

• Day shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Roadside assistance is mainly during working hours. If you are willing to help outside working hours when needed, this is a plus.

Are you an experienced payroll and HR administration professional who enjoys ownership, accuracy, and variety?
